summary: Iter 31 — Fetch My Best Factors (Step 2) + Trash screen verified end-to-end. Backend pytest: 9 passed, 1 skipped (graceful empty path for /api/ai/suggest-factors when LLM budget is exhausted — used_model:null, factors:[] — PASS per spec). Auth-required (401) and 404-on-unknown-decision both confirmed. Trash CRUD: GET /api/trash, POST /api/trash/{id}/restore, DELETE /api/trash/{id}, DELETE /api/trash all return 200 with correct shapes; DELETE /api/pros-cons/{id} correctly moves the item to the trash collection with module=pros_cons, days_left between 0–7, and restore returns the doc to its original collection (verified by listing pros_cons after restore). Regression /api/ai/find-best-options still returns 200. Frontend (mobile 390x844): purple 'Fetch My Best Factors' button renders below the Step 2 description on /prr/{id}; tapping it shows the graceful 'No suggestions' alert dialog (because both Claude and gpt-4.1-mini calls hit Budget exceeded 0.425>0.4 in this preview) — UI handles it cleanly and the user remains on Step 2. /trash screen loads via deep link and via Profile → 'Recently Deleted' row; shows item card with module icon, label tag, deletion date, days-left pill, Restore (purple) button, trash icon, and an 'Empty' action in the header. Profile shows the 'Recently Deleted — Restore deleted items within 7 days' entry. KNOWN ENV: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget remains exceeded so AI factor suggestions cannot be generated in this preview — this is the same env issue reported in iter 30, not a code bug.

issues: Purple 'Fetch My Best Factors' button is well-sized (~44pt+), has spinner state, and a small (11px) hint line — legible and not crowded.
Card layout shows icon + title + label tag + deleted-date + days-left pill + Restore + delete-icon — all required elements present. 'Empty' action surfaces only when items > 0 (good).

action_items: Add testID props to the Step 2 'Fetch My Best Factors' button (e.g. testID="fetch-best-factors-btn") and to Trash row controls (testID="trash-item-{id}", "trash-restore-btn", "trash-delete-btn", "trash-empty-btn") for stable mobile automation — currently only accessibilityLabel is set.

Optional UX: when both LLM providers fail (used_model:null AND factors:[]), the alert says 'No suggestions, AI could not suggest factors this time.' — consider explicitly mentioning 'AI temporarily unavailable, try again later' so users don't think the AI thought there were 0 good factors for their decision.
Top-up the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget so the Fetch My Best Factors AI path can be QA'd end-to-end with real suggestions (current preview cap: 0.4 exceeded by 0.425).
critical_code_review_comments: ai_tools.py suggest_factors() correctly bypasses LLM exceptions (try/except around both Claude and gpt-4.1-mini), dedupes case-insensitively against existing decision.factors, clamps priority to 1..10 and expected_value_pct to 0..100 — robust.
trash.py restore correctly re-inserts the saved document only if no row with the same id_field already exists (prevents duplicate-key races on retried clicks).

Step2.tsx handleFetchBestFactors flow is solid: it disables the button while loading, surfaces a friendly error via showAlert, and reuses addFactorsFromTemplate so AI factors are normalized to the same shape as Social Learning imports.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (button renders, graceful-no-suggestions alert fires, Trash screen lists + restores items, Profile row visible)
